scope: Ownership refactor; wire/scientific versions unchanged. Static comparisons do not replace compiler, fixture or graphical acceptance.

material_static_comparison.parent_documentation_change: After the author comparison, DigestSourceMaterial documentation was attached inside dto! so rustdoc/schema documentation belongs to the type. Scientific fields, serde attributes and binary bytes are unchanged.

restoration.verification: Static comparison and owned-file rustfmt only; no compilation or tests.
invariants: apply_restored itself opens one Leptos batch; existing caller-level batches remain nested and preserve atomicity.
WorkspaceSession::begin_replacement advances workspace_epoch first; PcrState then advances pcr_generation before any feature install.
PlanState clears candidate_events and current verification evidence before restored candidate installation; retained candidate declarations do not restore a source-event authority receipt.
The 57 original explicitly written signal names all have direct owner methods; original cancellation/revision/epoch guards and worker cleanup effects remain unchanged.
Existing effects keep their relative registration order. Assembly previous-draft epoch effect is now registered by AssemblyState::new at the same position relative to other effects (first).
RestoredWorkspace validation remains before apply_restored; no fallback decoder, new format, scientific work, or asynchronous admission is introduced.
deliberate_changes: AssemblyState::restore clears previous_assembly_draft synchronously inside the batch, in addition to its existing epoch effect clearing it on the subsequent reactive flush.
Restoration is intrinsically atomic even when invoked without a caller-level batch; existing restoration callers and their batch boundaries are retained.
Plan invalidation and candidate pin resets occur earlier within the atomic restoration batch, before document installation, rather than at its tail; no intermediate reactive state is published.
restoration.evidence_limits: Owned files parsed by rustfmt; complete signal-name mapping and direct source inspection only. Native web model tests do not execute these WASM-only Leptos lifecycle controllers. Runtime callback/effect ordering has not been exercised; parent owns native/WASM integration checks. No browser or application HTTP checks performed.

free_functions_retained.chosen: Operates on borrowed bins and choice IDs, including when Construct mutably borrows its independent edits. No whole-Library dependency.
free_functions_retained.roles_for_active/identity/require_active: Access optional Library within Draft and compare working Draft state with retained choice state.
free_functions_retained.enable/save_active/for_storage/capture_a: Whole-Draft transactions with validation, snapshot normalization, source-role restoration and active-slot edits.
free_functions_retained.all_captures: Enumerates both working Draft captures and immutable library choices.

library_methods.evidence: Static body comparison and owned-file rustfmt only; no compiler/tests/runtime checks.
library_methods.comparison_normalization: Receiver ownership rewrite, whitespace and rustfmt trailing call commas only.

independent_material_review.scope: Function/method bodies, DTO attributes, version constants, private replay/installation ownership; excludes caller/compiler/runtime validation.

independent_worker_review.scope: Independently extracted original matches, current routes and handler bodies; scope is static and excludes runtime validation.

execution.scope: Affected scientific/transport/native SDK/sharing cases and native web models; does not execute WASM Leptos controller lifecycle.
